basic_details.job_title: RITES Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Hydrographic Surveyor, Dredge Master and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Four Individual Consultant positions at Gandhidham / Kandla, Gujarat are open with RITES Limited: Hydrographic Surveyor (1), Dredge Master (MOT Grade I/II) (2) and Financial Expert (1). Each engagement has an initial tenure of 12 months and payment of Rs. 1,60,000/- per month (Hydrographic Surveyor and Dredge Master) or Rs. 1,25,000/- per month (Financial Expert). The posts need experience in dredging work. Applications are submitted online in the Career Section of the RITES website (www.rites.com) from 25 November 2026 to 16 December 2026 (till 23:00). There is no application fee.

qualification.details: The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship or PhD research experience is not counted as experience. The date of acquiring a qualification is the earliest of: the last day of the month of the final examination (or the exact written-examination date when stated), the date of declaration of result, the date of issuance of marksheet, or the date of issuance of degree. No relaxation is given on this account. Where a specialization is required in the qualifying degree, the candidate must submit a certificate from the University/ Institution clearly specifying it. As per Rule 177 of GFR 2017, consulting services do not include direct engagement of retired Government servants; a retired Government servant can be hired as consultant through a competitive process, only for specific tasks and a specific duration. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of the RITES website, http://www.rites.com, by 16.12.2026 (till 23:00). A valid e-mail ID is essential.
Note the Registration No. that the system generates on top of the online form and quote it in all further communication with RITES.
Fill the "Identity Proof" details carefully; the same Identity Proof must be produced in original at later stages.
Upload clear scanned copies of all the documents listed below on the RITES website for successful submission.
Submit the application under "Fill/ Modify Application Form". Applications once submitted cannot be altered.
Print and sign the online application form with the registration number and bring it to the document verification/ interview with self-attested photocopies and originals of the documents.
Hard copies of documents are not to be sent to the office by post or courier. Candidates can apply for any number of vacancies.
Arrange these in the given order, from top to bottom:
High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth
Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks for all semesters/years (Xth, XIIth, Diploma/ Graduation/ Post-Graduation as applicable)
Experience certificates from previous employers for the claims made in the application
Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card etc)
Proof of different periods of experience claimed (if applicable)
Any other document in support of the candidature

For current employment, the experience certificate/ joining letter with the last 3 months' salary slips or last financial year/latest Form 16 must be produced at document verification. For proof of CTC/ salary, a copy of Form No. 16/ Earning Card/ salary slip/ Appraisal letter or other suitable document is required. Candidates must also bring or upload one filled copy of Annexure-A (Documents Submission Checklist), which also lists the last company relieving letter/experience certificate and NOC (for Govt./PSU employees) and 02 recent passport size colour photographs.
important_instructions: The consultant has the legal status of an Independent Consultant and is not a staff member or official of RITES Limited; no employer-employee relationship is created. The appointment is temporary; RITES can cancel it at any time without giving reasons. In the normal course, either side gives one month's notice. Consultants appointed on a full-time basis cannot take up any other assignment during the consultancy. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview, for joining or on completion of the assignment. Police verification is done as per MHA instructions; a negative report ends the contract immediately. Candidates working in any organization, including Government Departments/ PSUs, may join only after being properly relieved by their parent organization. Incorrect claims, suppression of facts, incomplete applications or insufficient proof lead to rejection; services are liable to be terminated if detected after engagement. Queries should be sent only to [email protected] with the VC No., Registration/Roll No., full name in block letters and the email given in the application. Corrigenda appear only on www.rites.com. Actual deployment or issue of the offer letter depends on award of work, project and company requirement.

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Limited describes itself in the notice as a multi-disciplinary Engineering and Consultancy organization providing services in all facets of transport infrastructure, building and other related technologies. Its Corporate Office is at Shikhar, Plot No.01, Sector-29, Gurugram-122001. The manpower in this recruitment is provided on CV-based assignments, and the consultants will be deployed at one of RITES's clients' sites.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 4 positions across three categories, all at Gandhidham / Kandla, Gujarat. The notice states that the number of vacancies may vary.

rows.post: Individual Consultant: Dredge Master (MOT Grade I/II)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on the last date of submission of application, 16.12.2026. The age limit for all three posts is not exceeding 64 years . The notice prints no age relaxation. Overall supervision and verifications of Hydrographic survey works with data processing knowledge. Execution of two or more projects as a Hydrographic Surveyor consisting of Capital / Maintenance dredging works. Comprehensive knowledge and expertise in Hydrographic Survey software PDS2000/ Hypack or equivalent (must have). Comprehensive knowledge of latest survey equipment on board. Overall supervision and verifications of Daily Dredge Quantity report (DDR), Draught and Load Monitoring (DLM), Track Plots, Quality Assurance & Control with interpretation knowledge. Basic understanding of Hydrographic Survey charts. Execution of two or more projects as a Dredge Master / Expert consisting of Capital / Maintenance dredging works. Knowledge of Hydrographic Survey software PDS2000/Hypack or equivalent (must have). Experience in dredging projects which includes scrutiny of tender, invoice and running account bills. Knowledge of GST and other commercial aspects (must have). The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship or PhD research experience is not counted as experience. The date of acquiring a qualification is the earliest of: the last day of the month of the final examination (or the exact written-examination date when stated), the date of declaration of result, the date of issuance of marksheet, or the date of issuance of degree. No relaxation is given on this account. Where a specialization is required in the qualifying degree, the candidate must submit a certificate from the University/ Institution clearly specifying it. As per Rule 177 of GFR 2017, consulting services do not include direct engagement of retired Government servants; a retired Government servant can be hired as consultant through a competitive process, only for specific tasks and a specific duration. Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Full-time bachelor's degree in civil engineering from a recognized university, OR Associate Member of Institution of Surveyors (India) Subdivision 1B in Hydrography, OR Master's degree in mathematics or physics
rows.experience: Total experience of 05 years as hydrographic surveyor in supervision of dredging/ dredge survey activities

rows.experience: Total Experience of 05 years as Dredge Master / Expert in supervision and monitoring of dredging activities on board dredge
Total Experience of 03 years in Dredging projects

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Payment for services is Rs. 1,60,000/- per month for the Hydrographic Surveyor and Dredge Master (MOT Grade I/II), and Rs. 1,25,000/- per month for the Financial Expert. Payment is released within one week after completion of the month, based on the attendance registered by the consultant. Consultants are entitled to payment for their service only and not to statutory benefits like PF/ESI/Gratuity. Income Tax or other applicable tax is deducted at source, with TDS certificates issued; Goods and Service Tax, as applicable, is admissible to the consultant. For a contract of more than one year, remuneration may be reviewed annually; any enhancement is based on escalation received in the client's fee for the previous year. The tentative project/work duration and the initial tenure for each post are 12 months, extendable based on the performance of the individual and/or requirement of the project. Extension is one year at a time, on the same project only, and depends on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on Key Performance Indicators. No extension is given beyond the age of 65 years. Leave is at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year; absence up to one month may be considered without remuneration. Women consultants may be eligible for maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is interview only, preceded by document scrutiny. All candidates who successfully submit the online application are provisionally allowed to appear for document scrutiny/verification of eligibility. Only eligible/shortlisted candidates then appear for the personal interview, which evaluates technical skills, subject knowledge, experience, and communication and interpersonal skills. RITES reserves the right to shortlist candidates out of the eligible ones. Document scrutiny (tentative): 17th & 18th December 2026. Interview (tentative): 22.12.2026 (Tuesday). Venue: RITES Corporate Office, Shikhar, Plot No.01, Sector-29, Gurugram-122001, OR through video conferencing/online. The online link is shared through the registered mail id / official chat group. For in-person document scrutiny, bring all original documents with one set of photocopies. RITES may issue a date-wise schedule depending on the volume of applications. Results will be uploaded on the RITES website with Post Name/ Number, Registration number and Name, marked Suitable/ Not found suitable. CVs of all suitable candidates are shared with the Client; only candidates whose CVs the Client approves get the Engagement Letter.
